content: Methods for Ear Clearing: 1. Yawning: 2. Swallowing: 3. Valsalva Maneuver: This involves pinching the nose, closing the mouth, and attempting to exhale gently through the nose. If the hands are unavailable to pinch the nose, it is possible to train the compressor naris muscles in the face to perform this action. Ruptured Eardrum: Additionally, if cold water enters the middle ear through the ruptured eardrum, it can cool the inner ear, potentially causing vertigo. Damage to Other Air-Filled Spaces: This may occur if the sinus ducts are damaged or obstructed. Important Precautions: Divers should undergo proper training to learn safe and effective ear-clearing techniques.
